messages:
Maya (CS): Quick sync — we need a clean, short customer-facing update + follow-up plan for the 12 onboarding tenants hit by last night's inference latency spike. I put a draft below. Please review, suggest edits, and claim outreach ownership.

Alex (Support): Saw the draft, looks good. We should include expected timeline for credits and a short FAQ. Also confirm who sends the in-console notice vs email.

Jonah (Solutions): I can take the high-touch accounts (3 of the 12) — will add personalized notes about their integration points.

Priya (Eng): Root cause summary for the customer: transient autoscaling bug + slow warmup for quantized model variants. We rolled a hotfix at 02:15 UTC and added a safety limiter to autoscaler. Metrics show latency back to normal by 02:50 UTC.

Sam (Product): Add a short line about mitigations we put in place to avoid recurrence, and mention monitoring/alerting improvements. Keep it non-technical.

Maya (CS): Great — here's the draft email/in-console copy. Mark edits inline and add reactions for accept.

```
Subject: Brief update on last night’s inference latency — your account impacted

Hi {{customer_name}},

We want to let you know about a service incident that affected inference latency for a subset of customers during a maintenance window yesterday (Mar 20 UTC). Your account experienced elevated latencies between ~01:42–02:50 UTC which may have impacted onboarding batch runs and interactive requests.

What happened (short): a transient autoscaling regression combined with warmup delays for certain optimized model variants caused increased tail latency. Our engineering team deployed a hotfix and adjusted autoscaling safeguards. Performance returned to normal by ~02:50 UTC.

What we did for you: we restarted affected worker pools for your onboarding jobs, retried queued requests where feasible, and validated end-to-end request success for recent runs.

Next steps: we will issue a small service credit for the impacted window and follow up with a high-touch review if you prefer. If you saw failed onboarding items, reply and we’ll prioritize remediation.

If you want a technical recap or a walkthrough, mention that in your reply and Jonah will follow up.

Thanks for your patience — we’re sorry for the disruption.

— The Redwood Support Team
```

Alex (Support): I suggest adding a one-line bullet about customer data never being exposed.

Maya (CS): Good call. Add: "No customer data was exposed; this was an availability issue only."

Priya (Eng): Can we add an optional appendix link to the full RCA hosted on our status page? E.g., https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2189-2026-03-20 . Keep as optional for high-touch accounts.

Sam (Product): I'll sign off on the wording. Keep the subject concise.

Maya (CS): Assigning owners: Alex — send the in-console notice to all 12 by EOD today; Alex + Jonah — joint email for the 3 high-touch accounts (personalize) by EOD; Maya — follow-up check-in for renewal-risk accounts next week; Priya — confirm production mitigations and post RCA link; Ops Bot — add incident tag INC-2189 and set reminder for 7-day follow-up.

Alex (Support): Claimed the in-console notice and the bulk email. Will post a copy of the message here before sending.

Jonah (Solutions): Claimed the 3 high-touch personalized emails. I’ll pull recent logs for each and include one-sentence impact summaries.

Priya (Eng): Patch committed to main at 03:10 UTC. We added a conservative warmup policy for quantized variants and a backstop to autoscaling triggers. Full tech RCA will be published to status once legal signs off. ETA 48 hours.

Ops Bot: Incident created: INC-2189 | Severity: S2 | Owner: Priya (Eng) | Link: https://internal.incidents/INC-2189

Maya (CS): Action checklist (copyable):
- [ ] Finalize in-console copy (Alex)
- [ ] Send bulk email and log sends (Alex)
- [ ] Send high-touch personalized emails (Jonah)
- [ ] Publish RCA link to status (Priya + Legal)
- [ ] Apply service credit to 12 accounts and confirm amounts (Billing + Maya)

Maya (CS): Notes on credits: propose a standard one-off credit equivalent to 2 hours of provisioned Dedicated throughput converted to usage credit; billing to confirm amounts and finalize wording.

Alex (Support): Will add a brief FAQ: expected credit timeline (within 3 business days), how to request a deeper review, confirmation that SSO/data security unaffected.

Maya (CS): OK — final asks: Alex, post in-console + send bulk email today. Jonah, high-touch emails today. Priya, RCA link or placeholder by EOD tomorrow. I'll prepare the renewal-risk outreach plan for next week and sync with Sam. Any objections?

Sam (Product): No objections. Suggest we track replies in this thread for handoff notes.

Maya (CS): Thanks all — please add reactions when tasks are done.

Alex (Support): Posting final console copy now. Will paste logs of sends when complete. :thumbsup:

Jonah (Solutions): Drafts for the 3 accounts posted below; will send after final quick review.

Priya (Eng): RCA placeholder created and shared with Legal. Will update link once approved.

Maya (CS): Closing this thread once sends are confirmed.

Ops Bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 7 days for customer replies and credit confirmations.
